note: Declared inputs of the scripts/gate.sh units that cost tens of seconds and read a small part of the tree (docs/ci.md#pre-merge-gate). Patterns as in .github/ci-inputs.json, after the `defaults` inputs; `lean`: modules, .lean files or directories whose package imports count, transitively. A declared unit passes only in a restricted worktree that withholds every other tracked file (scripts/ci-reuse.py RestrictedWorktree), so a declaration that misses an input fails the unit. Every other unit keys the whole checkout.
